name: Fallout 4: Pip-Boy
summary: Your Pip-Boy on the bottom screen: inventory, quests, maps, stats and radio.
description: A native Rust/Vulkan companion using Fallout 4's built-in Pip-Boy app connection. Maps and art are extracted from your installed game. Restores the companion service for Steam version 1.11.240.0 in a private launch overlay; other executable versions are skipped. No F4SE or game DLL injection required.
